environment.description: Quarkus native image deployed as a Knative serverless function on GKE Autopilot cluster. Pod runs in namespace 'functions' with default service account. No network restrictions applied. GKE metadata server (GKE_METADATA) is enabled on node pool but workload identity is not configured for this specific namespace, so the default compute service account credentials are accessible via the metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254.
